controls.evidence: Complete native role census identifies this 3-of-5 Safe as DEFAULT_ADMIN, rewarder and blacklist manager and the timelock proposer. Owner identities are recorded; module pagination is empty with sentinel 0x1 and guard/module-guard slots zero. redistributeLockedAmount can burn/remint a restricted holder balance without increasing net supply; seizure and cooldown/loss powers remain adverse. The current exact implementation prevents this Safe from directly granting the upgrade role. Human signer independence is not asserted.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 26197398 (2026-10-15T10:44:47Z), the implementation slot remains 0x6561272e3ebc9f2e07cdb12b7c474db9132b977a and its full runtime matches verified source. Complete RoleGranted/RoleRevoked replay over exact vault and current timelock, blocks 25275301-26197398, returns 141 events and resolves the native authority census: DEFAULT_ADMIN=0x0c6bbfd2d5666d44bf28580edeec0263692c8316; REWARDER=that Safe and 0xa0c49ffa4b7941830235cde974d9b2a8420cd375; BLACKLIST_MANAGER=that Safe and 0xb1e50b7a19b8f650a6ee77dc0ac52b88059fa169; TIMELOCK_ADMIN=0xa952453e39f77108ee37c1b92de593f1c59a6ef4. Current hasRole checks corroborate these memberships and exclude the Safe from TIMELOCK_ADMIN_ROLE. The replay also retains address-specific restricted-staker memberships, which cannot authorize minting. Timelock proposer is the Safe, executor 0x039e71e865a34bcaaebfc641291bec6517ea0ce7 and canceller 0x60226cbb34445143e5f923abe2d42e5df852d065; no DEFAULT_ADMIN member remains. getMinDelay=86400. The owner Safe is 3-of-5 with the recorded five owners, empty module pagination, zero guard/module-guard slots and the recorded fallback handler. pendingDefaultAdmin is zero and defaultAdminDelay=86400. Direct grantRole/revokeRole cannot replace TIMELOCK_ADMIN_ROLE; setTimelockAdmin requires its current holder. Current cooldown is 604800 seconds, mutable by DEFAULT_ADMIN up to 90 days. REWARDER reportLoss can burn backing up to 500 basis points per report, at least 86400 seconds apart. Restricted-holder redistribution/seizure and these impairment powers remain adverse. Sherlock and Nethermind cover earlier staking/access/oracle code, not proven build-equivalent September 2026 code. The issuer advertises a continuous critical bounty up to $1M, not financial assurance.
